question: Magkano ang porsyento ng Basic Real Property Tax at Special Education Fund sa Davao City?
answer:
Sa Davao City, ang Basic Real Property Tax ay ina-impose sa isang libu-libong limang porsyento (1.5%) ng assessed value ng real property, grasslands, buildings, machinery, at iba pang improvements na nasa Davao City. Ang Special Education Fund (SEF) ay ina-impose ng isang porsyento (1%) na additional levy sa assessed value ng real property, na ito'y magiging additional sa basic real property tax. Ang mga kita mula sa SEF ay magiging kasama lamang sa SEF.

ground_truth: Annex11 states Basic Real Property Tax is 1.5% of assessed value and the additional Special Education Fund levy is 1% of assessed value. Their arithmetic sum is 2.5% of assessed value; this sum is derived from the two stated rates.
